before.story: EU Proposes Big Tech Tax
before.summary: European Council President António Costa proposed a 3% digital tax on tech companies with at least €50 million in annual EU digital revenue and €750 million in global turnover to help finance the 2028–2034 EU budget, while trimming €204 billion ($224 billion) from the European Commission's initial spending plan. France immediately rejected the proposal as inadequate, while European businesses warned EU leaders against budget cuts that could harm competitiveness.

before.story: Cargo Ship Carrying Diesel Sinks Off Ibiza
before.summary: Spanish authorities launched an emergency marine pollution plan after a cargo tanker carrying 7,000 tons of diesel fuel sank 46 kilometers off the coast of Ibiza. One crew member was killed and six others were injured in the Wednesday accident, which saw 17 personnel rescued as the vessel went down.

after.story: Cargo Ship Carrying Diesel Sinks Off Ibiza
after.summary: A Maltese-flagged cargo tanker carrying approximately 7,000 tonnes of diesel fuel capsized and sank 46 kilometers off the coast of Ibiza, Spain, killing one crew member and injuring six others while 17 personnel were rescued. Spanish maritime authorities launched an emergency marine pollution plan to contain potential oil spills and protect ecologically sensitive Mediterranean waters.
